title: cacalia verbascoides
intro: Cacalia verbascoides, commonly known as Wild Sweetleaf or Yomogi, is a plant species in the aster family (Asteraceae). It is native to East Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia verbascoides are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which are said to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
